figurative_meaning_en: A worthless or useless person; a specific form of insult
example_sentences_in_english: He is completely useless at work, like an untimely pumpkin.
This guy is a real good-for-nothing in society.
history: The idiom originates from Bengali agricultural life, where pumpkins (কুষ্মাণ্ড) grown out of season (অকাল) are small, bitter, and unproductive, symbolizing worthlessness.
note: This idiom reflects rural Bengali farming culture and is used colloquially to demean someone's utility.
